values.value: A daily rate used for children with additional care needs based on a physical and/or mental disability and/or who needs a higher level of care than peers of the same age; can be up to twice the Regular Rate; is paid to providers who document when the additional care needs are with a request for additional payment that is not more than would be charged to the general public along with professional/physician's statement from the adult caretaker verifying the needs (see rule for reference)
